relations.statement: For a weight-preserving sign-reversing involution, each pair satisfies w(c)*sign(c) + w(tau c)*sign(tau c) = 0
Zero signed sum does not require a pairing: [2,-1,-1] sums to 0
A cancelling doublet can carry a nonzero observable numerator: 1+(-1)=0 and 1*1+(-1)*(-1)=2

lemmas.statement: For each path p, weight(p)*toInt(sign p) + weight(tau p)*toInt(sign(tau p)) = 0
lemmas.lean_skeleton: example {P : Type u} {T : FrustratedSpectrumObstruction.TrotterPath P} (inv : FrustratedSpectrumObstruction.BipartiteInvolution T) (p : P) := FrustratedSpectrumObstruction.bipartite_pair_exact_cancellation inv p

lemmas.statement: Involution is sufficient but not necessary for zero signed sum

near_misses.claim: Zero signed sum implies an involution pairing exists
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: (+2,-1,-1) sums to 0 but has odd size, so no fixed-point-free involution exists

near_misses.claim: A cancelling pair gives zero observable numerator
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Requires A o tau = A; for the doublet with A = sign, the numerator is 2
